'''Dinosaur Mayonnaise''' is an [[Artisan Goods|Artisan Good]] made by placing a [[Dinosaur Egg]] in the [[Mayonnaise Machine]], taking 3 hours.

==Bundles==
Dinosaur Mayonnaise is an option for {{bundle|missing||y}}.

==Tailoring==
Dinosaur Mayonnaise is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Dinosaur Pants.png|36px]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Dinosaur Pants]].

==Quests==
Dinosaur Mayonnaise is not used in any [[quests]].

==Trivia==
Although [[Sam]] hates [[Mayonnaise]], [[Duck Mayonnaise]], and [[Void Mayonnaise]], he likes Dinosaur Mayonnaise as a gift.
